title: Poland holds suspect in alleged assassination plot against PM Tusk

blocks.text: WARSAW — Polish police are investigating after arresting a man suspected of plotting an attack against Prime Minister Donald Tusk and defense minister Wladyslaw Kosiniak-Kamysz, the interior ministry told AFP on Sunday. Searches were continuing at the suspect’s home, ministry spokeswoman Karolina Galecka said, adding: “information about this man will of course then be verified by the police.” This came after Tusk and interior minister Marcin Kierwinski said that a suspect had been detained. “The man threatening an attack has been detained,” Tusk wrote on X, praising the police for their “swift and decisive action”.
